people.imagined: In the Pool House, she has turned a sitter's chair so the person faces away from the basin. She herself looks only into the water at the sitter's reflection, never at the sitter, with an even, unfriendly calm.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the rim of a round stone basin of still water she looks DOWN into it with her head bowed and her eyes fixed on a reflection, deliberately not looking up at the viewer. Face: a smooth, composed, pale oval face; downcast long-lidded dark eyes; thin level brows; a small straight nose; thin lips, neutral and cold; a faint blue thread-shadow from the collar on her chin. Hair: black, in a tight knot on top pinned with a long thin brush; no other ornament. Body: slim, straight, still. Clothing: a robe of undyed grey silk, fine and perfectly pressed, crossed collar with a thin BLUE thread along the edge, wide sleeves whose cuffs are stained solid black with ink; a plain grey sash. Hands and objects: in the right hand a fine long brush poised over a sheet of pale paper laid flat on a low table (no drawing), the left hand flat on the basin's rim; a round basin of black still water, in which the reflection of a face (the viewer's) can just be made out as a pale oval. Background: blurred pale studio walls, a window with cloud-white light. Light: cool white light from the upper left, a faint blue-green reflected shimmer from the water on her chin; a faint water qi hint. Expression: calm, cautious, callous; she sees only what the water shows.

people.imagined: Early morning at the grinding stone, teaching a novice the one-breath stroke. He has demonstrated once, and now holds his open right palm up to show the ink in it, as if this were the lesson.
people.subject: The moment: at a stone ink-slab he holds his open RIGHT palm up toward the viewer as if showing a lesson, a long inkstick in the other hand. Face: a lean, calm, weathered fisherman's face, brown and lined; patient narrow grey eyes; thin grey brows; a long nose; a small neat grey beard; a closed, gentle mouth. Sun-creases run from his eyes like fishing-line. Hair: grey, tied in a small knot on top and pinned with a plain brush. Body: tall, narrow, upright, long hands. Clothing: an undyed grey silk robe, fine and clean, crossed collar, wide sleeves with cuffs stained solid black; a grey sash. The sleeves are wide and cut generously so that the black cuffs frame his raised palm. Hands and objects (the palm must read): the right palm is stained so deeply black with ink that the lines of the hand look like a tattoo, a dark inky pattern covering the whole palm and fingers, held up and facing the viewer; in the left hand a long black inkstick; before him a dark stone ink slab with a pool of ink. Background: blurred pale abbey room, a window and a gentle cloud shadow on the wall. Light: soft grey cloud-light from the upper left, a faint blue-green water qi hint. Expression: a patient, quiet, nearly smiling calm, eyes soft and unhurried, the face of a man who believes the stroke can only be taught by being shown once.

people.imagined: Grinding ink for the hundredth time. He starts the stroke, draws his breath in halfway, stops, frowns, puzzled, and looks at his thumbs, which smell of pine.
people.subject: The moment: at a grinding slab he has stopped mid-stroke with an inkstick in his hand and is frowning at his own thumb in gentle puzzlement. Face: a plain, round, open young face with a slight, patient puzzlement; mild brown eyes; soft brows tilted; a short nose; a small closed mouth. A faint grey streak of ink is on his left cheek where he has rested his hand. Hair: black, short, a little untidy, with a thin brush stuck in it a little crooked. Body: slim, a little awkward, rounded shoulders. Clothing: an undyed grey silk robe of plain neat cut with a crossed collar, wide sleeves with cuffs stained black with ink; a grey sash. Hands and objects: the thumbs of both hands show a clear amber-brown sticky resin stain under the nails, the near thumb lifted for the viewer; the other hand holds a long black inkstick over a dark stone slab; a small block of pale pine resin beside it. Background: blurred plain grey room, a window with pale cloud-light. A shelf of small ink-cakes and a neat pile of washed brushes stand behind him in cloud-grey shadow. Light: soft grey light from the upper left, a faint green wood qi hint. Expression: patient, trusting, calm; puzzled at himself.

people.imagined: At the ink house, tending a pot where agarwood burns slowly to soot. She is humming, and she leans her head toward the smoke without noticing it clings to her hair.
people.subject: The moment: bent over a small clay burner with a thread of dark smoke rising she lifts her head and smiles warmly at the viewer, a curl of smoke wrapping her loose hair. Face: a round, soft, warm face, golden-brown; bright dark eyes with laugh lines; soft arched brows; a small nose with a smudge of soot; a wide generous mouth in a smile. Her cheeks are rounded with the smile and faintly pink from the heat of the little burner. Hair: black, long, worn loose over one shoulder, with visible wisps of pale grey smoke curling through it and clinging, the main feature. Body: sturdy, small, round-shouldered. Clothing: an undyed grey silk robe, fine, clean and soft, crossed collar, sleeves tied back with cord, cuffs stained solid black with ink; a grey sash; a small cloth over the shoulders. Hands and objects: a small clay incense burner with a glowing coal and a dark resinous lump of agarwood, a thin plume of smoke; in the other hand a flat bone spoon with a dark soot scraping. Background: blurred shelves of small black ink cakes, a window. A shaft of window light lies across the floor and picks out slow coils of smoke. Light: warm soft light from the upper left, a hazy brown smoke glow; a faint water qi hint. Expression: a warm, generous, relaxed smile with the eyes crinkled, humming contentment, the face of a woman who has never been in a bad mood for long.

people.imagined: At the Triều Âm dock, he is carrying a roll of scrolls under his arm and turns his hand to admire a gold-leaf ring too big for his finger, worn on his thumb. He is thinking about how well he forges.
people.subject: The moment: on a harbour dock he holds up his right hand, thumb extended, to admire a large gold ring on it, with a sly, pleased look at the viewer. Face: a lean, sharp, handsome young face; quick black eyes; thin arched brows, one raised; a thin nose; a sly, smooth smile; a little tanned from dock work. A thin line of black ink runs under his thumbnail and a faint tan mark shows where a hat usually sits. Hair: black, in a neat topknot with a gilded pin, a loose strand. Body: wiry, quick, cocky, shoulders back. Clothing: a grey silk robe of a slightly flashier cut than the abbey's, crossed collar with a blue-black edge, cuffs stained with ink; a belt with a small brass buckle. Hands and objects: a thick GOLD ring far too big for his finger worn on the THUMB, clearly visible and gleaming; under his left arm a bundle of narrow scroll rolls with gilt ends; a brush tucked behind his ear. A little gold glint bounces off the ring across his cheekbone. Background: blurred harbour with masts and a pale sky, a gull. Light: bright sea light from the upper left, a glint on the ring; a faint water qi hint. Expression: a sly, glossy, pleased smile, one brow raised and the eyes bright with the thought of how well he forges, entirely sure of himself.

people.imagined: In the cane grove alone, cutting stalks, he stops and, thinking nobody is looking, taps out brush strokes on his knee with his fingers, a whole sweeping landscape. Then he looks round.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a cut bamboo stalk in a grove he taps the fingers of his right hand on his knee as though tracing brush-strokes, eyes distant, then glances sideways to check he is unseen. Face: a thin, gentle, shy young face; large dark dreamy eyes; soft level brows; a straight small nose; a closed, hiding mouth. A thin sheen of sweat is on his forehead from cutting and a green flake of cane clings to his eyebrow. Hair: black, short, with a straw hat pushed back on his neck. Body: thin, long-limbed, a little stooped. Clothing: a plain undyed grey hemp-silk jacket of fine weave, clean, with a crossed collar and sleeves rolled up; cuffs with a faint ink stain; a cane-cutter's cloth belt. His trousers are rolled to the knee, bare feet are in plain straw sandals, and green sap stains one cuff. Hands and objects: the right hand lifted in mid-stroke with the fingers curved like holding a brush; a short bamboo-cutting knife across his lap; cut green canes at his feet. Background: blurred tall green bamboo trunks, dappled light. Behind him a fan of pale green stalks tapers to a tiny bright patch of sky. Light: green-gold dappled light from the upper left; a faint green wood qi hint. Expression: reclusive, humble, loyal; hiding a gift.

people.imagined: At the Pool House table, sitting on the very edge of her chair, braced, as if the chair might be a trick or the room might shift. She watches the next chair, where her double sits.
people.subject: The moment: seated rigidly on the very front edge of a chair, back stiff, both hands gripping the seat edge, eyes darting suspiciously round the room toward the viewer. Face: a narrow, pale, wary face; wide light-brown eyes with whites showing; fine arched brows drawn tight; a small pointed nose; a thin tense mouth. A fine film of cold sweat shows on her upper lip and one eyebrow is higher than the other. Hair: dark brown, tied back in a bun with a brush pin, a strand across her cheek. A few loose strands are tucked tightly behind each ear, as if to leave nothing hidden. Body: slender, braced, tense shoulders, feet flat on the floor as if ready to rise. Clothing: an undyed grey silk robe with a thin BLUE thread at the crossed collar, wide sleeves with black ink-stained cuffs; a grey sash. Hands and objects: her hands white-knuckled on the chair edge; beside her, a second identical chair with a pale, faintly translucent paper-like double of herself in the same robe sitting calmly. A small bell hangs from the chair-back and a cup of tea at her elbow sits untouched. Background: blurred pale Pool House with a bronze mirror and a window of cloud-light. Light: cool grey-white from the upper left, a faint blue-green water qi hint. Expression: loyal, honest, paranoid.

people.imagined: On the abbey's terrace at morning, looking up at the sky instead of at the person talking to her, one brush held lightly, deciding today's cloud. She has not heard the question.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a terrace at morning, she looks up and slightly away at the sky, one slender hand lifted with a brush, and has clearly not heard what the viewer said. Face: a slight, fine-boned, serene face with small deep lines; pale grey eyes lifted toward the sky; thin silvery brows; a small straight nose; a soft, absent, half-smiling mouth; ink in the creases of the nose-side lines. Hair: pale grey, gathered into a high topknot pinned with a very worn, old brush, the handle dark and chipped. Body: small, slight, straight, nearly weightless. Clothing: an undyed silk robe of delicate fine grey silk with a crossed collar and wide sleeves, cuffs stained black; on the front of the robe, a small soft grey-white cloud shape painted faintly, one cloud; a plain grey sash. Hands and objects: ink-stained crease lines in all her fingers; an old worn brush in her right hand; a roll of plain unpainted silk under her left arm. Background: a vast soft sky of pale clouds blurred, a rail of the terrace. Light: bright soft cloud-light from the upper left, a faint blue water qi hint. Expression: content, reclusive, patient; her mind is in the clouds.

people.imagined: At the Pool House with a scroll case in his hand, selling a scroll to a visiting buyer; he smooths the jade weight with his thumb while the buyer thinks about the price. He already knows it.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a bright studio he holds a scroll case toward the viewer with a smooth, generous smile, thumb stroking a jade weight at its end. Face: a handsome, round, well-fed face; smooth rosy skin; bright, shrewd dark eyes; strong arched brows; a straight nose; full lips in a warm confident smile with a trace of cruelty; a neat, short black beard and moustache. The skin around his eyes is soft and unlined, a prosperous man's face. Hair: black, glossy, in a neat topknot with a jade pin. Body: tall, broad, comfortable, a prosperous man. Clothing: a grey silk robe of far better cut than the abbey allows, fine, lustrous, crossed collar edged in blue thread, wide sleeves, cuffs lightly ink-stained; a broad dark grey sash with a small jade clasp. Hands and objects: a long lacquered scroll case with gilt ends and a hanging JADE weight, held out; a round bronze mirror on the wall behind him, showing a second sky. Background: blurred bright studio, a window, rolls of scrolls. Tall rolled scrolls stand upright in a stand, and a window shows a soft blue sky. Light: warm bright light from the upper left, a gleam on jade; a faint water qi hint. Expression: a smooth, warm, practised smile with a thin edge of coldness in the eyes, the open friendliness of a man who already knows the price.

people.imagined: Standing at a huge sheet of paper at the Pool House, painting fast, sleeves tied back, a smear of blue ink along her jaw. She has been told to sit and has not. She is hunting the sail in the pool.
people.subject: The moment: standing at an easel-like board she turns a quick glance at the viewer with a wet brush raised mid-stroke, a long streak of blue ink along her jaw. Face (most important: the blue smear): a thin, sharp, intense face; a bold smear of bright BLUE ink from the left ear along the jawline, clearly visible; keen dark eyes; strong thin brows; a straight nose; a tight, stubborn mouth. A small crease of concentration sits between her brows. Hair: black, in a high tight knot pinned by two brushes, escaping strands. Body: thin, wiry, upright, always standing. Clothing: an undyed grey silk robe with a thin BLUE thread at the crossed collar, the sleeves TIED BACK with cords above the elbow to free the arms; cuffs stained black; a grey sash. Hands and objects: a wet brush in the right hand dripping blue; before her a tall board with pale paper carrying only a half-painted blue-grey sky with the faint edge of a small white sail; a small mirror-bright dish of blue ink. Background: blurred Pool House, a window over a dark pool. Behind the board a long window opens on a dark, still pool with a hint of mist above it. Light: bright grey-white light from the upper left, a faint blue-green water qi hint. Expression: a tight, restless, hunting look, eyes narrowed on something she has not caught yet and the mouth pressed in stubborn impatience.

people.imagined: In the paper mill with a straw hat on indoors and arms wet to the elbows in pulp, he lifts a fresh sheet from the vat and tilts it to the light, counting something in his head and not liking the number.
people.subject: The moment: at a pulp vat, he lifts a frame bearing a wet sheet of pale paper and tilts it toward the window light, squinting. Face: a broad, round, ruddy, tired face; small shrewd brown eyes in folds; heavy brows; a big nose; a wide, downturned mouth; grey stubble. White flecks of pulp dot his stubble and a faint pulp-whitened line runs along the hat's edge. Hair: grey, thin, mostly hidden under a wide straw hat worn indoors. Body: broad, stooped, heavy arms, a barrel chest. Clothing: an undyed grey hemp-silk robe, fine and clean but the sleeves rolled to the shoulder; a wet cloth apron; his forearms wet and coated pale with white pulp to the elbow, clearly visible. Hands and objects: a wooden mould frame with a wet sheet held up, dripping; on the wall behind, stacks of drying paper and a tally of notches. A wet strip of bamboo hangs from his belt and a small wooden tally with notches is hooked at the hip. Background: blurred mill, steam, rows of drying sheets, bamboo canes stacked. Light: grey window light from the upper left, steam haze; a faint green wood qi hint. The window light catches the translucent wet sheet and puts a pale glow on his face from below. Expression: diligent, deceitful, reclusive; a man who has kept a secret as long as he has kept a vat.

people.imagined: At the soot hearth at Trầm Hương Trấn, she lifts her head at a visitor's step and tucks her burned fingertips into her sleeves at once, as she does whenever anyone looks.
people.subject: The moment: at a smoky hearth she has just tucked both hands inside her wide sleeves and looks up with a calm, polite, closed face. Face: a calm, oval, composed face; pale grey eyes with fine lines; thin straight brows; a small nose with a smudge of soot at the tip; soft thin lips in a small smile. A few fine lines fan from the corners of her eyes. Hair: black with a few grey strands, knotted low and pinned with a plain brush; a veil of smoke haze near it. Body: slim, upright, quiet. Clothing: an undyed grey silk robe of fine cut, crossed collar, wide sleeves with the cuffs stained black with soot and ink; a grey sash; a long dark apron. The long dark apron is clean at the chest though soot-grey along the lower hem. Hands and objects: both hands hidden inside her sleeves, only a hint of dark burned fingertips peeking out at one cuff; behind her, a clay hearth with a cone of dark soot and a plume of fragrant smoke; a row of small black ink cakes on a rack. Background: blurred soot-dark hearth room, brown haze. Light: warm low brown light from the lower left, grey light from the upper left; a faint water qi hint. Expression: a calm, polite, closed face, the lips curved in the smallest courteous smile and the pale eyes steady, hiding everything under it.

people.imagined: At a market stall, wearing yet another hat, he spreads out a scroll with a flourish and signs with a gleam in his eye, knowing the buyer will triple the price. He already has a hat for the next market.
people.subject: The moment: at a market stall he unrolls a scroll with a flourish, one hand lifted to tip his hat to the viewer, a roguish wink. Face: a quick, lean, young-looking, clean-shaven face; bright dark eyes with a wink; thin arched brows; a slim nose; a quick, charming, half-grin. A little dimple shows in his left cheek. Hair: black, glossy, partly covered by a jaunty round red-brown felt hat with a small feather, a different hat from the last market. Body: slim, lively, a dandy's tilt. Clothing: a grey silk robe of an artful cut with a crossed collar and sleeves rolled, cuffs black with ink; a bright coloured scarf of orange at the neck; a broad belt. Hands and objects: on his back a travelling pack with GILT scroll-ends sticking up like a bundle of gold-tipped spears; one hand tipping the hat; a scroll rolled out on the stall before him showing just a soft grey cloud wash (no writing). Background: blurred market stalls, awnings, colourful hanging lanterns. Cloth awnings in red, yellow and green overhang stacked wares, and a crowd moves softly out of focus. Light: warm midday market light from the upper left, a glint on the gilt; a faint water qi hint. Expression: a quick, roguish wink and a charming half-grin, brows dancing, the face of a rascal delighted by the sale and already thinking of the next hat.

people.imagined: On the abbey step with her sleeve pushed back to show the small inked outline of a brush on the inside of her wrist, she traces it with her other finger, thinking of the only lesson she was given.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a stone step she pushes back her left sleeve and traces with her right forefinger an inked outline of a brush on the inside of her left wrist, looking down at it. Face: a plain, round, gentle young face; downcast dark eyes with long lashes; soft brows; a short nose; a small calm mouth. A small crease of concentration sits between her brows and her lashes cast thin shadows on her cheeks. Hair: black, in two small buns pinned with brush pins, a loose braid down the back. Body: slender, upright, small. Clothing: an undyed grey silk robe, fine, clean, crossed collar, wide sleeves (the left pushed back to the elbow), cuffs stained black; a grey sash. Hands and objects (the tattoo must read): on the inside of the left wrist, a clearly drawn black outline of a long brush, empty, with nothing filled in, running along the forearm; in the right hand a thin brush with a dry tip. Her fingertips are only lightly inked, the ink on the right index finger fresh and black, the rest clean. Background: blurred willow branches drooping over a pale wall. Light: soft grey-green light from the upper left, a faint green wood qi hint. Dappled shade from drooping willow leaves moves over the wall behind her. Expression: humble, patient, content; she believes what she was told.

people.imagined: Dozing in the shade of the pulp vat with his sleeves dripping, a straw hat on his face, while another boy beats his share of pulp behind him. He is dreaming of clouds.
people.subject: The moment: sprawled in the cool shade beside a vat, his hat over his eyes and one arm flung out, deeply asleep with a small smile. Face: a round, boyish, sunburnt face partly under a hat brim; a loose, smiling mouth slightly open; a short flat nose; freckles. A smear of white pulp sits on his chin and a thread of drool dampens the corner of his mouth. Hair: black, short, damp. A damp cowlick sticks up and a flake of bamboo is caught in the hair above his ear. Body: sturdy, relaxed, big hands. One leg is stretched out and the other knee bent, with a bare foot still wet and the toes curled in sleep. Clothing: an undyed grey hemp-silk jacket with sleeves SOAKING WET and heavy with white pulp, visibly dark and dripping, clinging to his arms, the main detail; a crossed collar; wide trousers; a rope belt. The trousers are rolled to the knee and soaked dark with pulp water in drips and spots. Hands and objects: his wet sleeve dripping onto the floor; beside him a wooden beater mallet leaning on a vat; a small painted cloud drawn on a scrap of paper in his fist. Background: blurred mill vats, steam, another boy beating pulp out of focus. Light: soft green-grey shade from the upper left; a faint water qi hint. Expression: lazy, gregarious, forgiving; happily asleep.

people.imagined: Standing knee-deep in the mangrove shallows with her hems soaked, painting a root. She glances up and grins as if she has just told a lie to a clerk. She is teaching the double to talk.
people.subject: The moment: standing ankle-deep in shallow brackish water, she holds a brush mid-stroke over a sheet pinned to a board and looks up with a sly, loyal grin. Face: a sun-browned, strong, bright face; clever dark eyes with a glint; strongly arched brows; a straight nose; a wide mischievous mouth. Fine freckles dot the bridge of her nose and a smear of ink marks her chin. Hair: black, in a high ponytail tied with a green cord, wet at the ends. Body: strong, medium height, planted in the water. Clothing: an undyed grey silk robe with a thin BLUE thread at the collar, the hem soaked dark and dripping, clinging round her calves, clearly visible; sleeves rolled up. Both bare forearms are inked with black mangrove-root lines, many tangled branching lines winding from wrist to elbow, clearly visible. Hands and objects: a brush in the right hand, a board with a pinned sheet of a half-painted root; a small ink dish floating on a plank. Background: blurred green mangrove roots arching over brown water, soft mist. Pale light dapples the water and a white heron stands far off among the roots. Light: soft green-gold light from the upper left, a faint blue-green water qi hint. Expression: a sly, bright, mischievous grin with a glint in the eye, the face of a girl who would lie to a clerk for a friend and enjoy every word.

people.imagined: In the novices' room, she counts brushes under her breath in a row, chewing at her fingernails, and gives the viewer a quick wary look because she knows she is being added up in turn.
people.subject: The moment: in a plain room she stands over a row of brushes lined up on a cloth, one fingernail between her teeth, counting under her breath, and sends a quick suspicious glance at the viewer. Face: a thin, sharp young face; restless dark eyes with shadows beneath; thin straight brows; a small nose; a mouth chewing a thumbnail, the nails of both hands bitten down to raw pink quick, clearly visible. Her lower lip is raw and a small bitten patch shows at the corner of the mouth, her gaze flicking between brushes. Hair: dark brown, in a tight braid pinned up with a brush. Short wisps escape the braid at her temples and are damp with nervous sweat. Body: slim, tense, hunched shoulders. Clothing: a plain undyed grey silk robe, clean and neat, crossed collar, narrow sleeves with ink-stained cuffs; a grey sash. Hands and objects: the right hand at her mouth with a bitten thumbnail; a long row of exactly twelve thin brushes laid out in a neat line on a pale cloth; a small slate tally of notches. Background: blurred plain room, a bare window. A narrow bed with a folded blanket and a second row of neatly folded robes behind her. Light: cool grey light from the upper left, a faint green wood qi hint. Expression: ambitious, faithless, paranoid; counting everything including you.

people.imagined: At dusk, an old servant with ink-black ears walks up to the pool to tell his blind master the colour of the clouds, shuffling, his hands full of what he will say.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk an old servant stands at a pool's edge turning his face toward the sky as if reading it aloud, one hand raised to describe a colour. Face (most important: black-rimmed ears): a thin, kindly, old, much-wrinkled face; both ears have rims dark with ink, jet black along the whole edge from top to lobe, plainly visible; calm pale brown eyes; sparse white brows; a thin nose; a soft toothless mouth. Deep age spots dot his temples and the skin of his hands is thin as paper. Hair: sparse white, tied in a thin short queue. Body: small, bent, thin, shuffling. Clothing: an undyed grey hemp-silk servant's jacket of plain neat cut with a crossed collar and short plain sleeves, clean and soft; a grey sash; no robe of rank. The jacket is a good soft weave and its cuffs are pressed neat, though the fingers that poke from them are bent with age. Hands and objects: the right hand lifted, open, describing a cloud; the left hand holds a small ink-stained stone grinder; below, still dark water reflecting a dusk sky of soft pink and violet. Background: blurred dusk pool and a distant island. Light: soft rosy dusk light from the upper left; a faint water qi hint. Expression: a soft, faithful, toothless half-smile, eyes raised and a little misty, the face of a servant who will report the sky exactly as it is.

people.imagined: The founder in his last years, painting old reflections at the pool's edge, brush lifted over a pale sky the pool once held. He is half in the sky himself.
people.subject: The moment: at the edge of a still pool an old scholar holds a long thin brush lifted over a sheet, gazing into the water; the picture is faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. Face: a long, gaunt, noble, scholarly face; a thin white beard to the chest; deep-set pale eyes, distant and quiet; long white brows; a high forehead; a gentle line of a mouth. Long fine lines like cracks in old glaze run from his eyes to the temples and the beard is combed to a thin point. Hair: long white hair tied in a topknot with a worn cane brush. Body: tall, thin, upright with a slight stoop. Clothing: a long scholar's robe of undyed silk with a crossed collar and wide sleeves, the cuffs black with ink; a plain sash; a faint wash of pale cloud pattern at the hem. Hands and objects: a wolf-hair brush with a cane handle in the right hand; a roll of silk across the left arm; below him a round still pool with an upside-down pale sky in it. Several drops of dark ink have fallen on the silk before him and spread into soft grey cloud shapes. Background: faded pale sky and mist. Light: soft pale light from the upper left. The same aged cream tone covers everything, with thin dark craquelure lines across the surface like old varnish. Expression: patient, reclusive, devout; absorbed.

people.imagined: The Pool House painter in the winter of 1158 sitting before her own reflection-double and painting it, the double's face fixed and bright. She leans forward, eager to get the portrait right, unaware.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a table she leans eagerly toward a sheet while, across from her, a pale reflection-double of herself sits upright, its face bright and unmoving; the picture is faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. Face: a handsome, strong, impatient face; high cheekbones; keen dark eyes; fine arched brows; a straight nose; a compassionate, slightly open mouth. A thin crease of worry is between her brows and her lips are slightly parted as if about to speak to her double. Hair: black, in a high knot pinned with two brushes. Body: slim, leaning forward, tense with eagerness. Clothing: an undyed grey silk robe of fine cut with a thin BLUE thread at the crossed collar, wide sleeves with cuffs stained black; a plain sash. A little blue ink has dripped onto one sleeve and dried there as a small round blot. Hands and objects: a fine brush held in the right hand; before her a still bowl of water showing the double's face; across the table the pale, slightly translucent double in the same robe. Background: faded pale Pool House walls and window. Light: low pale winter light from the upper left. Expression: ambitious, impatient, compassionate; unaware. Hope and absorption, with no sign of the danger across the table.
